Removed legacy requirement for notify on final satisfaction, blocked conditions and 'onSatisfied=notify', replaced with zero notification side effects for challenge create/resolve/block/satisfy/reopen/cancel. Challenge query/queues, evidence and immutable state authoritative, unaffected by mute; explicit requeue yields Ready, no auto-Working; amended tests for no notifications under retries/concurrency and blocked/satisfied and mute. Sent ONE intentional owner notification to Worker 1 (seq1722) about spec change and need to explicitly adopt/repin new spec before work. Asked Worker1 to revise implementation/tests, freeze SHA, request independent review via shared queue, not notify named reviewer. No code edits, merge, deploy or direct reviewer notifications.
